derivation: The point of the mission works; 3 things didn't work and 4 couldn't be checked.
scoreMeaning: The point of the mission works; it would ship with 3 known issues that didn't work as asked and 4 items I could not check
whyThisGrade: MEDIUM because the point of the mission worked, but other things you asked for did not work or could not be checked. The point of the mission is 20 things — Reviews entry screen is the landing view…, Collection screen shows each bucket…, Builder matches the mockup… and 17 more — and all of them worked. Known issues shipping with it: primary buttons miss the mockup's icon-to-label proportion — you asked for primary buttons matching the mockup's compact single-line labels and…; the build gives the Pull, Continue and Lock month buttons with oversized glyphs and… (prd-21); the 'Pull data & start' button's oversized icon and wrapped label — you asked for a small download glyph beside a one-line 'Pull data & start' label; the build gives a download icon 1.45x the button that spills past its top and bottom… (part-pull data start) and the 'Continue to builder' button's oversized icon and wrapped label — you asked for a small arrow beside a one-line 'Continue to builder' label; the build gives an arrow icon 1.91x the button that spills past its edges, with the… (part-continueBtn). I could not check 4 things — Re-pull re-runs collection for automated KPIs only…, The Kpi interface exposes optional previousValue…, Typing an insight autosaves via a PUT… and 1 more; 16 smaller items I could not check, and they don't change the grade: A snapshot JSON object omitting every…, sourceDeltas reuses the existing…, An unknown #mbr/<x> segment falls back… and 13 more — see the list.
